outcome.label: Gross primary enrolment ratio (% of primary school-age population), World Bank SE.PRM.ENRR

treatment.description: First calendar year (school year) in which primary fees were abolished nationally, for eight countries: MWI 1994, UGA 1997, LSO 2000 (phased in from grade 1), TZA 2002 (alt_year 2001 = declaration), ZMB 2002 (low confidence), KEN 2003, RWA 2003, GHA 2005 (capitation grant scheme). All other countries have an empty first_year: they are undated comparison units not known to have abolished fees, not verified never-abolishers. The panel wb_primary_enrolment ends in 2010 (last cohort 2005 plus five years) so that later abolitions do not enter the comparison group.
